messages:
Priya Khatri: Heads-up — I pushed a lightweight prefill runbook for the Novablue pilot. Core goals: reduce cold-starts, surface renewal-risk signals early, and handoff clear ops steps. TL;DR below.
Jamal Ortiz: Nice — can you paste the checklist?
Priya Khatri: Sure. 1) Run tenant warmup (prefill batch) within first 24h with ~10k tokens total. 2) Use streaming:true for UI flows; fallback to non-stream at 300ms timeout. 3) Enable prefix cache TTL=6h for conversational contexts (shorten to 1h if billing-constrained). 4) Capture prompt set & error tags into /cs/prefill/alerts for QC. 5) Note model-variant routing for graceful degradation.
Maya Chen: For TTL — 6h is fine for most; for high-cost tenants default to 1h. Recommend batch_max_tokens=128 for models using quantized shards.
Jamal Ortiz: On streaming fallback — can we auto-failover to a smaller model variant (instead of failing the request)?
Priya Khatri: Yes — runbook suggests routing policy: primary -> redwood-4x, fallback -> redwood-3q. Add these keys: route:["redwood-4x","redwood-3q"], stream_timeout_ms:300, batch_max_tokens:128.
Tomasz Kowalski: Add a preflight renewal-risk score: if usage drops >40% within 7d of go-live, auto-flag AE + CS for cadence check-in.
Maya Chen: Also capture a tiny qualitative pulse after 3 successful sessions — 2 quick questions inside the app (ease + value). Helps catch churn early.
CS-Bot: ALERT: Novablue prefill job completed — 95% success, 4 slow calls (>1000ms), 2 model fallbacks recorded.
Priya Khatri: Thanks. Jamal, can you triage the 4 slow calls and attach top traces here? We want to know if it's latency or backend retry noise.
Jamal Ortiz: On it. Will run the sampling query and post top 10 slow traces in ~30m.
Maya Chen: I'll draft the customer-facing one-pager for handoff — lean ops checklist + rollback steps + contact matrix. Keep it <1 page.
Tomasz Kowalski: Also: add a "prefill:planned" tag so SRE knows spikes are intentional and avoid noisy paging. Update the runbook under 'oncall' section.
Priya Khatri: Good call. Add tag prefill:planned and note expected throughput/cc window in the job metadata.
Jamal Ortiz: Sample query I'll run: `SELECT * FROM traces WHERE tenant='novablue' AND duration>1000 ORDER BY duration DESC LIMIT 20;` Posting results in thread after analysis.
Priya Khatri: Action items recap: (1) logs + traces — Jamal; (2) one-pager + AE handoff email — Maya; (3) runbook edit + tag — Tomasz; (4) I'll coordinate AE confirmation and close the loop. :thumbsup:
Maya Chen: Scheduling a 15-min sync after logs are posted. I'll include the one-pager draft in the calendar invite.
CS-Bot: REMINDER: create ticket CS-6942 for renewal-risk follow-up (auto-generated).
Priya Khatri: If anyone spots repeated model fallbacks, note model variant & prompt family — we'll feed to Optimize for quantization/batching adjustments.
Jamal Ortiz: Posted trace samples (attached). Two of the slow calls had spike in db lookups, one had 2xx but >1s due to tenant-side middleware.
Priya Khatri: Perfect — Maya, include that note in the one-pager (db latency risks). Tomasz, add fallback metrics to runbook (fallback-rate threshold = 3% per hour to trigger rollback).
Tomasz Kowalski: Will do. Updating runbook now and adding fallback-rate alert in /cs/alerts.
Priya Khatri: Closing: thanks team. I'll send the AE + Novablue summary once the one-pager and logs are attached.
Maya Chen: Done. Draft sent to thread and calendar invite created.
CS-Bot: NOTE: Thread archived after 7 days of inactivity.
